name: Shiplog
summary: Release notes on a timeline rail: filter by New, Improved or Fixed and launch a rocket to subscribe
about: A changelog section for a shop app: each release is a card on a timeline rail that draws itself on load, with diamond nodes that pulse while a release is unread. Open a release to see its changes slide in, filter the whole log to New, Improved or Fixed and watch lines and empty releases fold away, react with a heart or a rocket, or copy a link to one version. Subscribing rumbles a little rocket that launches out of the button in a trail of puffs.
how: Tap a release header to open or close it; opening an unread release marks it read.
Press New, Improved or Fixed to keep only those changes; All brings everything back.
Use the heart and rocket to react to a release, or Link to copy a link to it.
Mark all read pops every unread node with a spark.
Type your email and press Notify me: the rocket rumbles and launches, and Undo takes it back.
